import_method: direct Git blob extraction from the pinned tree
import_verification: All 43 original files byte-identical to the pinned Git blobs before commit.
scope: First public paper-era release for Section 4.1.1 MovieLens and Amazon experiments. It contains no released production data, production checkpoints, M-FALCON serving stack, or optimized HSTU kernels.
known_public_release_issues: The first README reports incorrect MovieLens-1M HSTU and HSTU-large headline rows; the PMLR paper and current README are used as the target source.
The Amazon Gin files bind removed parameter train_fn.item_feature_embedding_dim; upstream removed those bindings in commit 88acd0308bb549e005ae6532ee54585457e1b4a4.

paper.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
paper.publication: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235:58484-58509, 2024

later_upstream_review.purpose: Historical comparison only. Later code adds optimized Triton/CUDA operators, DLRMv3, and HSTU Ultra; it is not the source used for the paper-era public reproduction.
